parameter.name: hostname
parameter.label: Hostname
parameter.description: Hostname or IP address of the Solarman logger.

parameter.name: serialNumber
parameter.label: Logger Serial Number
parameter.description: Unsigned serial number of the Solarman logger, not the inverter serial number.

parameter.name: refreshInterval
parameter.label: Refresh Interval
parameter.description: Interval between batched reads. A write requests an immediate readback.

parameter.name: solarmanLoggerMode
parameter.label: Logger Mode
parameter.description: Select V5 for Wi-Fi loggers or RAW Modbus for compatible LAN loggers.

parameter.name: timeZone
parameter.label: Device Time Zone
parameter.description: IANA time zone used for the inverter clock, for example Europe/Lisbon. Defaults to the openHAB system time zone.

parameter.name: slaveId
parameter.label: Modbus Slave ID
parameter.description: Modbus unit address of the inverter connected to the logger.
